# IsAIokay.com

> IsAIokay.com measures the allowance and value delivered by AI coding subscriptions using privacy-safe metadata from real coding sessions.

The public ranking combines observed tokens, model and reasoning-effort mix, quota-window evidence, time-valid API-equivalent pricing, subscription price, and optional result satisfaction. Plans remain pending until privacy, coverage, and confidence thresholds are met.

## Primary resources

- [Coding subscription rankings](https://isaiokay.com/): Current observed allowance, API-equivalent value, model mix, satisfaction, and evidence confidence.
- [Methodology](https://isaiokay.com/#methodology): How prompt-free telemetry becomes privacy-thresholded subscription comparisons.
- [Sitemap](https://isaiokay.com/sitemap.xml): Public pages intended for indexing.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/isaiokay-com/isAIOkay): Open-source website and CLI implementation, documentation, and contribution history.

## Policies

- [Privacy policy](https://isaiokay.com/privacy): Data collection, public-profile visibility, GitHub identity, and anti-abuse handling.
- [Terms of use](https://isaiokay.com/terms): Participation rules and service limitations.

## Optional

- [CLI documentation](https://github.com/isaiokay-com/isAIOkay/blob/main/docs/cli.md): How the local CLI tracks subscriptions, models, effort, tokens, and quota without collecting code or prompts.
